Reverted. The weekly check read "if we are currently at capacity, adopters will be directed to sign up for a waitlist" from ACC’s adoption page as a statement that it had stopped taking animals. It is a conditional, it is about visitors rather than intake, and ACC is the city’s open-admission shelter, which cannot refuse intake. Showing it as closed would send someone with nowhere else to go nowhere at all.
